title: Indigo Swimlane — Quarterly Milestone Grid
description: A four-quarter horizontal swimlane roadmap with pill-shaped milestones, tri-color status dots, and a dashed today-rule — built to replace spreadsheet exports in internal product reviews where accountability is non-negotiable.
philosophy: This template exists for the moment a product team must defend a roadmap to stakeholders who have five minutes and pointed questions. It refuses decorative gradients, hero imagery, and narrative layout in favor of strict geometric structure: every element either carries schedule information or enforces the visual hierarchy that makes that information findable in under three seconds. The deep midnight ground suppresses distraction while soft swimlane banding keeps workstreams legible across a large conference room. It is designed for accountability, not aspiration.
goodFor: Internal product-review decks tracking three or more concurrent workstreams
Engineering sprint planning presented to cross-functional leads
Quarterly OKR alignment sessions requiring live milestone-status visibility
Executive briefings where schedule slip must be readable from across the table
avoidFor: External sales or investor pitches where operational vocabulary alienates the audience
Single-topic narrative storytelling slides built around a focal image
Chart-heavy financial reviews that need full-bleed graph real estate
Workshops requiring audience annotation or collaborative whiteboard fill-in
author: harness

examples.promptCore: The slide should feel like the cover sheet of a high-stakes engineering review — purposeful, stripped of ceremony, every element earning its place. A deep midnight ground anchors authority, with the right half carrying ghost-like geometric banding that telegraphs the swimlane system waiting inside. Compositional weight is decisively left-anchored, producing asymmetric tension rather than centered calm. Avoid all warmth and softness: no glows, no gradient washes, no illustrative flourishes — only ruled lines, restrained structural banding, and hierarchy enforced through contrast alone.

examples.layoutNotes: 12-column grid; title block occupies cols 1–7, vertically centered at roughly 42% from top, anchored by a full-width 1px rule beneath the headline to separate it from the subtitle descriptor. Cols 8–12 hold a muted ghost rendering of the swimlane column grid — faint quarterly divisions and two or three dim horizontal lane bands — serving as structural foreshadowing. Outer margin is a tight 6% buffer with no decorative bleed; a date or deck-version stamp sits bottom-right outside the main content zone.

examples.promptCore: The slide radiates controlled tension — every element answers 'what is late and who owns it' before a question is asked. Swimlane banding builds quiet horizontal rhythm against the deep midnight ground; pill milestones and tri-color status dots are the only points of warmth or urgency in an otherwise austere field. Composition is dense-modular but never crowded, keeping rows scannable at conference-room distance. Avoid decorative flourish, gradient fills, or any asymmetric hero element — strict geometric rigor is the sole aesthetic.

examples.layoutNotes: 12-column grid with cols 1–2 reserved for left-anchored workstream row labels, separated from the timeline area by a hairline vertical rule; cols 3–12 divide into four equal quarter segments delineated by subtle column rules. Horizontal swimlane bands stack vertically at consistent row height, each hosting pill-shaped milestone chips positioned proportionally within their quarter cell. A dashed vertical today-rule crosses all swimlane rows at the current-date position. Tri-color status dots anchor flush to the left edge of each pill; page number sits bottom-right with no decorative header band.
